messages.author: 1c44d55fe94f67dc
messages.subject: Loading data from datasets
parts:
Hi, 
I try to use a dataset from an installed package, with the function data(myDataset) but unfortunately, Shiny answers me that the object 'myDataset' is not found. in server.R when I want to load the datas with data() function.

 I first load the right library so the datasets are available. Here is an extract of the code of server.R:

library(pRolocdata)

datasetInput <- reactive(function() {
    switch(input$dataset,
           "tan2009r1" = tan2009r1,
           "at_chloro" = at_chloro,
           "dunkley2006" = dunkley2006)
   })


 output$data <- reactivePrint(function() {
     data(datasetInput())
    dataset <- datasetInput()
})

Is anyone may help me ?

Many thanks

Sam

What is the value of input$dataset? Can you show the exact error you are getting?

I have a function I use to get data from a package and assign to a reactive value.

loadPackData <- function(pFile) {

  robjname <- data(list = pFile)
  dat <- get(robjname)
  values[[robjname]] <- dat

}

Where 'values' is a reactive value set in global.R or server.R:

values <- reactiveValues()
